value.text:
This confirms the structure: a small abstraction package plus a concrete OAuth2 protocol implementation package.

h03.

The abstraction lives in `github.com/usememos/memos/internal/idp` (defines `IdentityProviderUserInfo`, the common identity-provider abstraction — see `internal/idp/idp.go`), and the concrete protocol implementation that ships is `github.com/usememos/memos/internal/idp/oauth2`, which implements the OAuth2 identity provider integration (token exchange, user info fetching, etc. — see `internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go`).

Answer: `internal/idp` (package `idp`); `internal/idp/oauth2` (package `oauth2`)
